mapper.insert: INSERT INTO concept_wishes (user_id, concept_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{conceptId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM concept_wishes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND concept_id = #{conceptId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM concepts WHERE id = #{conceptId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT wish_count FROM concepts WHERE id = #{conceptId}

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.category, c.difficulty, c.summary, c.wish_count, c.avg_rating FROM concept_wishes w JOIN concepts c ON c.id = w.concept_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY w.created_at DESC, w.concept_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM concept_wishes w JOIN concepts c ON c.id = w.concept_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED'
